officialPostgreSQLFinding.summary: The built-in boundary is FirstNormalObjectId minus one. Extensions within it are selected for ACL handling without definition; ordinary user-created extensions are selected by normal include/exclude policy. Normal dump output uses CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS with schema, intentionally omitting VERSION. Recreated plpgsql can have a user-range OID and therefore a definition entry. Catalog extension count is not archive definition count.
